instruction: Add the helloExtension from the Desktop directory as an unpacked extension in Chrome.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: Variation with paraphrased instruction asking to add the extension from Desktop directory. Verifies extension path is in installed extensions list.

Expected value '/home/user/Desktop/helloExtension' semantically matches the setup configuration which extracts helloExtension.zip to /home/user/Desktop/
Evaluator provides complete coverage: verifies the single requirement that the unpacked extension from Desktop directory was successfully added to Chrome
